clue.text: One who fights over secretary's shredder output

indicators.note: over means the fighter's word covers the secretary on both sides

parts.note: a scrapper is someone who fights, a scrap being a fight
PA, personal assistant, is a secretary; the 's is read as has

explanation.surface: A brawler squabbles over what the secretary's shredder spat out.
explanation.definitionFit: Waste sheets fed into a shredder come out as discarded paper for recycling or notes.

clue.text: Greek character breaks petty Cretan cross

indicators.note: breaks means the Greek letter splits the word for petty open

parts.note: minor means petty or trivial
tau is the Greek letter T

explanation.surface: A Greek man smashes a small cross made in Crete.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cross' is a hybrid here: the monster of Crete was half man, half bull.
explanation.definitionFit: The bull-headed monster of Knossos was a hybrid creature kept in a Cretan labyrinth.

clue.text: Priest loves storing shabby clothes for Murphy

indicators.note: storing means the two zeroes hold the clothes word between them

parts.note: love is zero in tennis scoring, written as O; two loves give OO
tat is cheap, shabby goods or clothing

explanation.surface: A cleric with a passion for hoarding old rags gives them to a Mr Murphy.
explanation.definitionFit: Murphy is an old slang term for the spud, from its link with Irish cooking.

clue.text: Hot singer's timeless gold disc

parts.note: H is short for hot, as on taps

indicators.note: timeless means the letter for time is removed

parts.note: an alto is a singer; the 's is read as is

explanation.surface: A popular singer's record, without age, has gone gold.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gold disc' suggests a record award, but it is the glowing ring round a saint's head. T is the usual abbreviation for time.
explanation.definitionFit: A halo is the ring of golden light painted round a saint's head.

clue.text: Two sorts of hose, almost flawless

indicators.note: almost means the last letter is dropped

parts.note: a water hose and hose meaning stockings or tights

explanation.surface: A shopper compares two kinds of hosiery that are nearly perfect.
explanation.definitionFit: An argument that is watertight has no holes in it, so it is without any weakness.

clue.text: Police dogs are trained to detect this number tag

definitions.text: Police dogs are trained to detect this
definitions.meaning: sniffer dogs look for the traces or signs of cannabis, known as hash
the # symbol marks a number and begins a tag on social media

explanation.surface: Sniffer dogs learn to spot a particular code on a tag.
explanation.definitionFit: The # symbol, also called the number or pound symbol, precedes a hashtag online.

clue.text: Look, there's George with his daughter!

parts.note: and means with
King George VI's daughter was Queen Elizabeth, whose royal cipher is ER

explanation.surface: Someone points out George arriving with his daughter.
explanation.definitionFit: To take a gander is British slang for having a look.

clue.text: Fine letter from 13 that's brought on board?

parts.note: F is short for fine, as on pencils
eta is a Greek letter, from the language of the philosopher at 13 across

explanation.surface: A fine letter from a famous writer that gets carried aboard a ship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'brought on board' suggests a ship, but the board is a cheeseboard.
explanation.definitionFit: The Greek brined cheese is the sort of thing served up on a cheeseboard.

clue.text: Sausage and tea to keep a pilot refreshed

indicators.note: to keep means the word for tea holds the other letters within it

parts.note: CHA is a slang word for tea

indicators.note: refreshed suggests the letters of a pilot are freshened up into a new order

explanation.surface: A snack of a sausage and a cuppa to revive a tired pilot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'refreshed' sounds like the pilot's tea break but is the anagram signal, and 'to keep' wraps the tea word round the result.
explanation.definitionFit: A chipolata is a small thin pork sausage.

clue.text: Love break in hospital department

indicators.note: in says the word for break sits inside the hospital department letters

parts.note: A and E, accident and emergency, is the casualty department of a British hospital
a gap is a break or opening

explanation.surface: A romance blossoms during a shift break in a hospital's emergency ward.
explanation.definitionFit: Agape is the Greek word for selfless, spiritual love, used in Christian theology.

clue.text: Green Party pursues a singer releasing record

indicators.note: pursues means the party word comes after the rest
releasing means the word for record is let go from the singer's word

parts.note: a vocalist is a singer
a list is a record of items
a do is a party

explanation.surface: The Green Party chases a pop singer who has just put out a record.
explanation.walkthrough: 'releasing' takes LIST from VOCALIST, leaving VOCA. 'Green Party' looks like one name, but Green is the definition and Party gives DO.
explanation.definitionFit: Avocado is a shade of dull yellowish green, named after the fruit's flesh.

clue.text: English companion with writer recalled Oz native

parts.note: CH stands for Companion of Honour, a British order

indicators.note: recalled is read as called back, so the letters run backwards

parts.note: and means with, as in bread and butter
the writer of a clue refers to themself as I

explanation.surface: An Englishman, a friend and an author remember an Australian they met.
explanation.definitionFit: The echidna, a spiny egg-laying mammal, is native to Australia, nicknamed Oz.

clue.text: Republic's author about to abandon army group

indicators.note: to abandon means the word for about is dropped from the army group

parts.note: a platoon is a small army unit
on means about, as in a book on birds

explanation.surface: The writer of a book about a republic is about to quit his military unit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to abandon' removes ON from PLATOON. 'about to' reads as a phrase meaning soon, but 'about' gives ON.
explanation.definitionFit: The Greek philosopher wrote the dialogue known as The Republic.

clue.text: Family boss, a Dubliner briefly stabling Arab horse

indicators.note: stabling means housing within, as a stable houses horses
briefly means the name is cut short by its last letter

parts.note: Patrick is taken as a typical Irish name, after Ireland's patron saint
AR is an abbreviation for Arab or Arabic
H is slang for heroin, which is also called horse

explanation.surface: A clan chief from Dublin keeps an Arab horse in his stable.
explanation.walkthrough: 'briefly' trims the name by its last letter and 'stabling' houses the Arab abbreviation; 'Arab horse' looks like one breed but gives two pieces. Patrick is Ireland's patron saint.
explanation.definitionFit: A patriarch is the male head of a family or tribe.

clue.text: What precedes fast time for tossers?

definitions.text: What precedes fast time for tossers?

parts.words: What precedes fast time for tossers?
parts.note: Shrove Tuesday comes just before the Lent fast, and those who flip pancakes are the tossers

explanation.surface: A cheeky question about what comes before a fast period for idiots.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tossers' is British slang for idiots, but here it means people flipping pancakes in a pan.
explanation.definitionFit: Shrove Tuesday, the day before Lent's fasting begins, is when pancakes are traditionally tossed.

clue.text: Chap's working out trips for guardians of apples

parts.note: a chap is he, and chap's is he's
PE, physical education, is working out
rides are trips or journeys

explanation.surface: A man exercises on outings to guard an orchard.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth these nymphs tended Hera's garden of golden apples.

clue.text: Way to reproduce endless Greek temple and first book

indicators.note: endless means the temple's name loses its final letter

parts.note: the Parthenon is the temple of Athena on the Athenian Acropolis
Genesis is the first book of the Bible

explanation.surface: Instructions for copying an old Greek temple along with the opening book of scripture.
explanation.definitionFit: Parthenogenesis is reproduction from an unfertilised egg, without a male.

clue.text: Poirot's strongman

parts.note: Agatha Christie's detective Hercule Poirot shares a first name with the mythical strongman, plus the possessive S

explanation.walkthrough: The detective's first name with the possessive S added gives the hero's name.
explanation.definitionFit: The mythical hero of the twelve labours is the archetype of physical might.

clue.text: Great to pass one day swigging litres

indicators.note: swigging means drinking in, so the litres letter goes inside

parts.note: to spend time is to pass it
L is the symbol for litres
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: It's great to while away a day knocking back litres of drink.
explanation.walkthrough: 'swigging' puts L inside SPEND, making SPLEND.
explanation.definitionFit: Splendid is an enthusiastic synonym for excellent or wonderful.

clue.text: Robin runs into ruddy animal

parts.note: ruddy means red

indicators.note: into means the runs letter goes inside the word for animal

parts.note: a beast is an animal
R is the cricket abbreviation for runs

explanation.surface: A man called Robin bumps into a wretched beast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ruddy' can be a mild British curse word, but here it just means red.
explanation.definitionFit: Redbreast is a traditional name for the robin, from its orange-red chest.

clue.text: Lawyer to call, wanting old plant

parts.note: DA is a US district attorney, a lawyer

indicators.note: wanting means lacking, so the letter for old is left out

parts.note: to phone is to call

explanation.surface: A lawyer wants to phone but doesn't want to deal with the old firm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wanting' removes O from PHONE, leaving PHNE.
explanation.definitionFit: Daphne is a genus of fragrant flowering shrubs.

clue.text: Material uni students gathered during half-term

indicators.note: during means the other letters fall within the half-term letters
half means only the front half of the word term is used

parts.note: U is short for university, informally uni
L is the learner driver's plate, and two learners gathered make LL

explanation.surface: Fabric that university students collected over the half-term break.
explanation.walkthrough: 'half' keeps the front of the word term and 'during' sets the other pieces within. Half-term is a short British school holiday in mid-term.
explanation.definitionFit: Tulle is a fine, net-like fabric used for veils and ballet skirts.

clue.text: Engineer left broadcasting, managing to dodge scandal?

indicators.note: to engineer is to contrive or rearrange, so the letters of left are shifted

parts.note: on air means broadcasting

explanation.surface: An engineer quits the broadcaster, cleverly escaping a scandal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Engineer' rearranges LEFT to TEFL. A Teflon politician is one to whom nothing sticks, like the non-stick coating.
explanation.definitionFit: The non-stick coating gives its name to public figures whom no scandal sticks to.

clue.text: New song about Disc World

indicators.note: about is read as on, so the song word sits on the disc word, coming after it

parts.note: an EP, an extended play record, is a disc
a tune is a song

explanation.surface: A fresh song about Discworld, the comic fantasy series.
explanation.walkthrough: Discworld is Terry Pratchett's series of fantasy novels, which makes 'Disc World' look like one name.
explanation.definitionFit: Neptune is a planet, and a planet is a world in astronomy and science fiction.

clue.text: Drama about a zoo keeper?

indicators.note: about means round, so the drama word goes around a

parts.note: Noh is classical Japanese masked drama

explanation.surface: A television drama about a zookeeper.
explanation.definitionFit: The biblical ark-builder kept pairs of every animal, a floating menagerie.

clue.text: Eastern females target one respected Turk

parts.note: F is short for female, doubled for the plural
an end is an aim or target
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Women from the East set their sights on a man of high standing in Turkey.
explanation.definitionFit: Effendi is a Turkish title of respect for a gentleman or official.

clue.text: Part of the chorus that's followed by foxtrot

indicators.note: Part of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A chorus line where a dance follows one number.
explanation.walkthrough: 'foxtrot' looks like the dance, but it is the NATO alphabet's word for F, which comes after the word for E.
explanation.definitionFit: In the NATO phonetic alphabet the code word for E comes just before the one for F.

clue.text: Berlin sharpshooter's orphan

definitions.meaning: Irving Berlin wrote the musical ... Get Your Gun about the markswoman Oakley
the musical about Little Orphan ..., the comic-strip girl

explanation.surface: The German capital's sniper turns out to have no parents.
explanation.definitionFit: Two musicals share the title character's name: Berlin's Oakley show and the Broadway hit about a parentless girl.

clue.text: Shell supports her in painting atrophied bananas

indicators.note: bananas means crazy, so the letters of atrophied go wild into a new order

explanation.surface: A painting of a scallop shell holding up a woman whose limbs have wasted away.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition recalls Botticelli's Birth of Venus, where the goddess stands on a scallop shell; Aphrodite is her Greek counterpart.
explanation.definitionFit: The love goddess, born from the sea, is shown standing on a shell in Botticelli's famous canvas.
